newsitem.title: UK: LME copper trades narrowly in evening inter-office.
newsitem.headline: LME copper trades narrowly in evening inter-office.

text.p: Copper prices held steady in light London Metal Exchange evening inter-office trading, holding most of the gains made earlier in the day.
The upcoming strike at Chile's Salvador mine and problems at Gold Fields Namibia facility were already in the market but were factors helping underpin prices, traders said.
The market was now awaiting LME stocks data on Friday morning for fresh trading stimulus.
Three months delivery copper at 1800 GMT was indicated at $1,952/$1,955 a tonne compared with $1,959/$1,960, the late afternoon high and Thursday's close around $1,943.
